title: Steno Pad
cues: Room 4B. Deposition. I typed every lie at two-twenty-five a minute.
Fluorescent Room 4B, a lone keyboard glows, stacks of papers tumble, a digital clock shows 2:25
build
Now the record is open. Your words. My timing.
A spinning vinyl record, a hand reaches to place a finger on the groove, shadows dance in the dark
build
You swore on a book you barely read then edited the truth in real time
A vast, grey library with towering shelves, a single lamp casts shadows
build
I caught the twitch in your jaw on line eighty-eight when the date did not match
A tense jaw clenches, a single hand trembles above a keyboard, a flickering light casts long shadows
drive
Counsel asked simple. You answered fog. I typed fog with perfect spelling
A sterile white desk, illuminated by a harsh blue glow, hands type rapidly
drive
Your alibi had alibis. Your witnesses had weekends. Your story had drafts
Layers of documents stack, a single hand reaches for a crumbling page, a sense of disorientation
drive
You said to the best of my knowledge like a shield made of wet paper
A wet, translucent paper shield collapses, a hand shields a flickering screen, a desperate gesture
drive
I have six pages of best-of-my-knowledge that contradict the other six
Six open pages, a hand pushes them back and forth, a focused, calculating gaze
drive
Do not stare at my machine like it is the enemy
A chrome machine sits in darkness, a silhouette observes, an ominous reflection
drive
The enemy is the paragraph you just walked into
A paragraph spins endlessly, a dark doorway looms, a sense of entrapment
drive
You smiled for the camera when the mic was off. I still typed the smile
A camera flash, a hand smiles mechanically, a cold, detached expression
drive
The record does not blink. The record does not like you either
The record spins, a dark eye stares back, silent judgment
drive
Cross-examination is a sport and you showed up in dress shoes on a gravel track
Dress shoes sink into gravel, a struggle for footing, a blurred silhouette fights for control
drive
Steno pad, steno pad, read it back
A cracked, black steno pad glows with an eerie, pulsing light
drive
Every word you ran from is staying on the track
Silhouetted figures in a dark corridor, endlessly repeating a step
drive
Steno pad, steno pad, black and white
A steno pad spins, black and white, time accelerates, a dizzying display
drive
You talk fast. I type faster. Good night
Two hands fly across keyboards, a frantic rhythm of light and motion
drive
You flexed a Rolex in a room with fluorescent shame
A Rolex gleams in the fluorescent light, a statement of excess and deception
drive
Judge did not look. I looked. Then I typed the brand name anyway for flavor
A lawyer's boot kicks a chair, a dark shadow, a calculated act
drive
Your lawyer kicked your chair. Cute. I footnoted the kick
Hands frantically sip water, a pattern emerges, a calculated pause
drive
Shit, you paused for water every time the question got warm
A dimly lit room, a figure pauses, a glass of water reflects a distorted face
drive
I timed the sips. Pattern. Three gulps then a dodge. Amateur hour
A rhythmic, slow-motion sequence of hands measuring droplets in a glass
drive
You called my job just typing. Brother, this is architecture
A dark corner, a hand rests on a keyboard, a quiet, relentless precision
drive
I build your mouth a house and then I lock the doors from inside
A hand locks a door, a final, decisive gesture, a sense of closure
drive
Now sit still. The record does not care about your feelings
A still silhouette sits, the record rotates, a dispassionate observation
drive
You misspoke, then unmisspoke, then blamed the grammar
A blurred, chaotic rush of color, punctuated by sharp, metallic angles
drive
I kept both versions. Side by side. Like a before-and-after of a liar
Two versions of a document side-by-side, a stark contrast, a revealing truth
drive
You stacked a second story on a first story that was already leaning then blamed the wind like weather did your lying
A leaning tower crumbles, the wind blows, a chaotic, destabilizing force
drive
Said you left at seven but the camera said eleven and your phone said you were nowhere near the scene you painted
A hand checks the time, seven then eleven, a fractured reality
drive
I am the quiet in the corner with the keys that never miss a consonant a comma or a crime you thought you buried
A dark corner, a hand manipulates keys, an unseen, silent power
drive
You want a battle go outside and find a mic in here I already won it is typed it is timed it is filed in triplicate
A microphone stands empty, keys glow, the battle is already won
drive
Exhibit C. Your own sentence.
Exhibit C – a hand points to the keyboard, the sentence echoes
drive
Smile for the transcript.
A hand smiles for the transcript, a manufactured serenity
drive
Every clause you twisted every date you shifted every name you half-forgot is lined up in my pad like a firing squad of
Clauses twist and turn, dates shift, names fade, a firing squad of evidence
drive
I do not need a mic I need a minute and a printer and your own damn vocabulary turning into evidence on contact
A hand reaches for a printer, a quiet determination, a final act
drive
You came in heavy talking verdicts like a billboard I came in quiet with a keyboard and a patience you cannot outrun
A hand types, relentless, unwavering, a force against the chaos
drive
Now the room is colder and your lawyer wants a break and I am still in tempo putting periods on every lie you spun
The room cools, a lawyer waits, the tempo remains, a persistent rhythm

You talk fast. I type faster. Good night
Two hands fly across keyboards, a frantic rhythm of light and motion
drive
Off the record? No.
A single word: 'Off the Record?' – a stark, unanswered question
drive
We do not do off the record.
Silence. The steno pad sits, a testament to truth and deception
